transcript.message: Jake, this is Lum from Outsource. Cold call, I'll be quick. You posted an SDR role two weeks ago, sixty-five to seventy-five OTE. We place full-time SDRs who work only for you from our office in Pristina for a fixed monthly fee, roughly a third of that loaded. Is the role real, or are you seeing who's out there?
Hah. Mostly seeing who's out there, honestly. And I pay fourteen hundred a month for a guy who does this already. Why would I pay you two and a half times that?
Maybe you shouldn't, that's what I want to figure out. What's the fourteen hundred getting you right now, how many meetings a month?
Two, maybe. I book more myself on LinkedIn.
And how long has he been with you?
This one, three months. He's the third in about fourteen months. First one vanished after six weeks, second one was fine and then took a full-time job.
So three resets in fourteen months, and each time you rewrote the sequences yourself. How much pipeline did each reset cost you, roughly?
About a month each time. Yeah. It's not great.

That's the part we're built for. You're not comparing us to the fourteen hundred, you're comparing us to the job post you haven't pulled the trigger on. Sixty-five to seventy-five OTE is over a hundred loaded, and the person can still leave in month four. Our seat is about thirty-five hundred a month all in, the person is a full-time employee in our office with a manager on the floor, and if they don't perform the clock stops and we replace them in about a week.
Okay, so what's the catch. What's the onboarding fee?

There is a one-time onboarding fee, and I'd rather Travis, our AE, walk you through the exact number with the contract in front of you than I guess it. What I can do today: give me ten minutes of brief and in seventy-two hours you get two or three profiles with video interviews. Nothing owed until you pick someone. Fifteen minutes Wednesday or Thursday to go through them?
Thursday at ten Eastern, fifteen minutes, profiles in your inbox by Wednesday. I'll send the invite to jake at lumenly dot ai?
